Major US banks are locking out external artificial intelligence agents that log into customer accounts without institutional approval. Financial institutions are restricting access that violates policies requiring account holders to log in personally, while reporting no rogue agents on their platforms.

Meta shares slumped roughly 6% after the social media giant reported negative cash flows in its quarterly financial statements and increased its capital expenditure projections. The company expects full-year expenditures to range between established limits, while quarterly cash metrics showed negative figures.

Jing Wang discussed scalable artificial intelligence infrastructure and secure integration during industry sessions. Wang emphasized that data, engineering, and governance must converge to build trustworthy solutions and create lasting value for investors in regulated environments.

University of Dayton researcher Ying-Ju Chen and an international team demonstrated how artificial intelligence can help factories detect flawed parts using fewer examples. The study showed that a pretrained model from OpenAI can inspect manufactured parts without requiring months of gathering thousands of labeled photos.
